name: [🎃EVENT] Solve The Cube
desc:
🧊 Have you ever solved a Rubik's Cube with your LIFE on the line? ⬜

Memorize the key sequence, type it from memory to turn and solve the cube, and beat your rival to it!
Pick ZERO ASSIST to solve a real scrambled cube yourself!

🔴 Set the fastest record! 
🔵 Compete in races with other players! 
🟡 Show us your puzzle skills! 
🟢 Different cube types, same real algorithms.

Can you solve a Rubik's cube? If so then this game is for you.

⭐ Favorite the game and come back to beat your best time!

Tags:

Cube, Puzzle, Rubiks cube, speedcubing, Solve, Rubiks, Rubik's, typing, memory
